Schnittstelle Operator3<A>

Typparameter:
A - the operand/result type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Fun3<A,A,A,A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Operator3<A> extends Fun3<A,A,A,A>

A ternary operator mapping three arguments to a result of the same type f: A × A × A → A.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • apply

      @Pure @NonNull A apply(@NonNull A a1, @NonNull A a2, @NonNull A a3)

      Applies this operator to the three operands.

      Contract: inputs must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Angegeben von:
      apply in Schnittstelle Fun3<A,A,A,A>
      Parameter:
      a1 - the first operand; must not be null
      a2 - the second operand; must not be null
      a3 - the third operand; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the result; never null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • andThen

      default Operator3<A> andThen(@NonNull UnaryOperator<A> after)

      Returns a composed operator that applies this and then the given UnaryOperator.

      Contract: after must not be null; intermediate and final results must not be null.

      Parameter:
      after - the unary post-operator; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a composed operator applying this and then after
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if after is null or any intermediate result is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • partial1

      default @NonNull Operator2<A> partial1(@NonNull Supplier<A> supplier)

      Partially applies this operator by supplying the first argument from a Supplier.

      Contract: the supplier and its value must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Angegeben von:
      partial1 in Schnittstelle Fun3<A,A,A,A>
      Parameter:
      supplier - supplies the first operand; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an Operator2 over the remaining arguments
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if the supplier or its value is null, or the result is null
      Seit:
